# Utility Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [TypeOf](/docs/standard-library/utility/typeof) | Gives the name of a value's type. |
| [Coalesce](/docs/standard-library/utility/coalesce) | Gives the first element of an array that is not null. |
| [ToString](/docs/standard-library/utility/tostring) | Converts a value to its string form. |
| [ToBoolean](/docs/standard-library/utility/toboolean) | Converts a value to a boolean by the language's truthiness rule. |
| [Keys](/docs/standard-library/utility/keys) | Lists the property names of an object. |
| [Values](/docs/standard-library/utility/values) | Lists the property values of an object. |
| [HasProperty](/docs/standard-library/utility/hasproperty) | Tells whether an object has a property of a given name. |
| [Merge](/docs/standard-library/utility/merge) | Combines the properties of several objects into one new object. |
| [Clone](/docs/standard-library/utility/clone) | Makes a deep copy of a value. |
| [NewGuid](/docs/standard-library/utility/newguid) | Makes a new random UUID string. |
| [Base64Encode](/docs/standard-library/utility/base64encode) | Encodes text as Base64. |
| [Base64Decode](/docs/standard-library/utility/base64decode) | Decodes Base64 text back to the text it encodes. |
| [FromJson](/docs/standard-library/utility/fromjson) | Reads JSON text into a value. |
| [ToJson](/docs/standard-library/utility/tojson) | Writes a value as JSON text. |
| [Sleep](/docs/standard-library/utility/sleep) | Pauses the script for a number of milliseconds. |
| [Diff](/docs/standard-library/utility/diff) | Compares two objects property by property. |
